capabilities: Reorder files and folders manually with drag and drop
Multi-select items and move, duplicate, or delete them in batches
Rename files and folders inline in the explorer
Import external files by dragging them from the operating system into the vault
Navigate and operate the explorer with keyboard shortcuts
disambiguation: Not an automatic sort-rule plugin; ordering is manual, done by dragging items into a custom sequence.
extras: Listed as pending approval in the Obsidian community plugin directory at time of writing; requires Obsidian 1.9.0 or newer; drag-and-drop reordering and context menus are desktop-only, mobile reflects desktop-defined ordering.
intentEvidence: This plugin is a completely separate file explorer from Obsidian's built in option.
problem: Obsidian's built-in file explorer only sorts alphabetically or by metadata and lacks multi-select batch actions and persistent manual ordering.
summary: Alternative file explorer view with drag-and-drop manual reordering, multi-select, batch operations, and persistent custom sort order.
